name: Bánh mì xíu mại
summary: A hot Da Lat breakfast: pork-meatball broth, a grilled baguette, shredded papaya, and herbs.
origin: Vietnam Tourism calls bánh mì xíu mại the Da Lat breakfast sandwich and says the bowl is served hot.
howToEat: The bowl is warm pork-meatball broth. The baguette is grilled. Shredded papaya and herbs come with it. Dip the bread.
Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note says the portions are small bowls, and names soy milk or yaourt beside them. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note names 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật. Vietnam Tourism describes the hot bowl and does not add a second recipe.
priceBand: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note prints about 10,000–15,000 VND a bowl. Vietnam Tourism prints no price.
